name: Top 10 branches by gross revenue this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
desc: Top branches ranked by MrpValue (gross revenue) for current month

name: Top 10 salespersons by gross revenue this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [SupplierName] AS Salesperson,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
desc: Salesperson ranking by MrpValue for current month

name: Top 10 categories by gross revenue this month
sql:

desc: Category-level sales ranking for current month

name: Today's total sales summary
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
desc: Today's gross revenue, quantity and bill count

name: Monthly sales trend — last 6 months
sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), '-', RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date)) AS varchar(2)), 2)) AS Month,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(month, -6, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date))
ORDER BY YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date)), MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date))
desc: Month-wise sales trend for the last 6 months

name: Top 10 articles by quantity sold this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [ArticleNo] AS Article,
  MAX([Color]) AS Color,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [ArticleNo]
ORDER BY TotalQty DESC
desc: Best-selling articles by pieces sold this month

name: Top 10 departments by gross revenue this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [DepartmentShortName] AS Department,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,

name: Top 10 vendors by purchase amount this month
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [SupplierName] AS Vendor,
  SUM(ISNULL([NetPurNetAmount], 0)) AS TotalPurchase
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
HAVING SUM(ISNULL([NetPurNetAmount], 0)) > 0
ORDER BY TotalPurchase DESC
desc: Vendor ranking by purchase amount for current month

name: This month vs last month gross revenue by branch
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) THEN [MrpValue] ELSE 0 END) AS ThisMonth,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
            AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) THEN [MrpValue] ELSE 0 END) AS LastMonth
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1))
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY ThisMonth DESC
desc: Side-by-side branch comparison: current month vs prior month

name: Top 20 highest selling articles all time by gross revenue
sql:
SELECT TOP 20
  [ArticleNo] AS Article,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
GROUP BY [ArticleNo]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
desc: All-time best sellers by gross revenue — no date filter
